    Owner access

    Admin controls — adding, editing, or deleting corrections and Language Bank entries, connecting sync, and importing an offline pack — stay hidden on a device until it's unlocked. Everyone else can still search, browse, and use every learning feature; they just can't change the shared content.

    Sign in with owner account (recommended)

    Required for cloud synchronization and multi-device management — unlocking this way also unlocks this device, so you won't be asked for the PIN too.

    Unlock with local PIN (offline mode)

    Only unlocks owner features on THIS device — it does not synchronize ownership or permissions to your other devices. Use this when Firebase isn't set up, you're offline, or you're working fully offline on purpose.

    Add a correction example

    Saved permanently in this file — no need to wait for a new version. This gets added to whichever category is selected above.

    Sync across devices

    Enter a sync code to view a shared correction log — anyone can do this, no unlocking needed. Sign in as the owner above to have your changes actually saved to it, enforced by the server.

    Import an offline vocabulary pack

    Choose a JSON file of vocabulary entries to add them to your Vocabulary Bank — works fully offline, same as words looked up online.
